_doc: Curated plant taxonomy for static/data/hf_datasets.json + datasets.json crop_types labels. 'labels' maps each raw lowercase crop_types value to a taxon (key into 'taxa'), optionally with a cultivar, a role/groups override, a review flag for uncertain identifications, or unresolved:true for noise. Labels with no taxon but a role/groups are group-level tags that attach to an inner tree node. Families follow APG IV as used by iNatAg. Add an entry here whenever a new crop_types value appears; tests/taxonomy.test.ts fails on unmapped labels.

ashoka.note: Could also be false ashoka (Polyalthia longifolia)

black mapte.note: Appears only alongside black gram; likely a local name

foliage flowers.note: Onion foliage/flower class, not a taxon

gum.note: DigitalGreen; could be guar or gum arabic

padri.note: DIMPSAR local name; possibly Stereospermum chelonoides

palm plantations.note: Colombian land-cover class; assumed oil palm

pepper.note: Mostly Capsicum; DIMPSAR's 'pepper' may be Piper nigrum

raktachandini.note: DIMPSAR local name; possibly Pterocarpus santalinus

white pear.note: fruitseg30 class; assumed Chinese white pear
